title: Awesome VTT – Demon Lord Character Builder
description: A guided character builder for Shadow of the Demon Lord, in the style of Hero Mancer: one window walks ancestry, attributes, paths, magic, professions and languages, background tables and starting equipment with a live preview, and levels existing characters up. Uses the ancestries, paths, spells and tables of the compendiums you own (such as the core book's); no game content is included.

recommends.reason: The core book's ancestries, paths, professions, spells, talents and tables, which the builder offers.
